name: Münster
kurzbeschreibung: Peaceful village in the Inntal with a beautiful Kirchenburg and stunning hikes up its Hausberg.
beschreibung:
Münster is idyllically nestled in the Tyrolean Inn Valley, just a few kilometers past the Bavarian border near Kiefersfelden. At an elevation of 534 meters, this charming village of around 3,400 residents extends along the Inn River, framed by the majestic Kaiser Mountains and gentle alpine meadows. Its strategic location makes Münster a serene base for exploring nature and rural culture, far removed from the busy crowds of nearby district hubs.

The heart of the village is its impressive fortified church complex, considered one of the largest and best-preserved fortified churches in Tyrol. With thick stone ramparts, covered battlements, and a prominent gate tower, it recalls centuries when villagers sought shelter from raiding forces. Around the Parish Church of St. Peter, charming narrow lanes and traditional alpine farmsteads invite visitors to stroll and pause. In summer, when alpine meadows blossom in full color, Münster unfolds its gentle, tranquil character.

Hikers can ascend directly onto the local mountains along well-marked routes, ranging from relaxed riverside rambles to challenging climbs toward Hochstein. In winter, cleared hiking trails and cross-country tracks cross the valley. Traditional Tyrolean inns serve authentic culinary favorites, offering travelers the deep peace and quiet that defines alpine village life.
